description.value: Local Public Eatery is a Canadian neighbourhood pub chain that positions itself as a community gathering spot, serving craft beer, local cocktails, poke bowls, and hand-pressed burgers in a lively, sports-friendly atmosphere. The River District location features a walk-in patio and a semi-private mezzanine Trophy Room that holds up to 80 guests. It is a full sit-down restaurant and bar with table reservations and party-booking options.
